title: The Naked Connection: Master Sex, Dating & Relationships
author: Kirsten Trammell
description: Welcome to The Naked Connection, a sex and relationship podcast for men who want deeper intimacy, better communication, and more fulfilling sex. Your host, Kirsten Trammell, helps men become legendary in bed and build meaningful romantic connections, by understanding how women actually experience desire, arousal, and attraction. She's a Tantric Practitioner trained in somatic and tantric traditions, with a Master's in Clinical Counseling. Each episode explores topics like lasting longer in bed, ditching performance anxiety, building real sexual confidence, how to do that dirty fetish you fantasize about, and the unconscious dynamics that build meaningful relationships. This is sex education for men, without shame, performance pressure, or gimmicks. If you want sex that feels connected, confident, and wildly pleasurable, you're in the right place. Let's get some!
